notes.title: Gravity Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
Touch Screen Support: Added full touch screen controls for mobile and tablet devices, enabling intuitive gameplay with tap and swipe gestures.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
General Optimization: Enhanced performance across all platforms, resulting in smoother gameplay and reduced loading times.

Level Rework: Revamped levels with improved design, better pacing, and refined difficulty curves to enhance player experience.
